title: Sunlit Apartment
summary: A WebGL still life of garden roses and peonies in a fluted water-filled vase with interactive sloshing caustics and raking afternoon sunlight.
description: An interactive Three.js still life of garden roses and peonies inside a water-filled, fluted glass vase. An open casement and slatted shutters rake sunlight across walnut, a botanical book, and the panelled wall with real-time spectral caustics and HDR bloom. Drag the vase or press Nudge vase to disturb the water, drag elsewhere to orbit, scroll to zoom, and press H to toggle controls.
